name: Kawasaki KE100 / KE125 / KE175
engine: 99 to 174 cc air-cooled two-stroke single, Superlube oil injection
intro: Kawasaki's small trail two-strokes. Oil injection, a simple frame and a very long production run on the KE100.

B: It has Kawasaki's Superlube oil injection, not premix. Keep the oil tank filled with two-stroke oil and check the pump cable and lines.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
